text: Is it okay to be jealous? After the question from Lana, where she broke up with a controlling guy, I received a question from a subscriber who struggles with trust issues in his relationship. Let's go to the question. Hi Ilyas, I really need your help on something. I have real bad trust issues. I cannot trust my girlfriend and always overthink. To the point it becomes ridiculous. The only thing she does is being really close to her female friend. She is bisexual. Who is bisexual? Her female friend or your girlfriend? And she used to kiss them. I guess they're both bisexual. And why them? So she used to kiss your... So your girlfriend used to kiss her female friend. Or maybe friends because you are saying them. Is it while you were dating already? Because then she cheated. And she used to kiss them but I told her I didn't like it and she stopped. But I'm just overthinking all the time. Even if she's perfect. Please, what is wrong with me? I need your help. Okay, let me try to be constructive here. Look, if you think you have trust issues. You get super jealous but you realize that there are not really any reasons there. Well, this is on you. I don't think I can help you here. I seriously think that in this case you should go and see a doctor. Psychologist, psychotherapist or psychiatrist. And work on your problem with a medical professional. Now, if it happens with a specific person and she gives you reasons for that. Well, it depends on the reasons of course. But here, if I read your question correctly. You know that your girlfriend is bisexual. And she kissed another girl or girls. Man, she cheated on you. In this case, it is barely an overthinking. And I really doubt that person who cheated on you can be perfect otherwise. Again, most probably you're just too inexperienced to see it. But your intuition is telling you something is wrong. Anyways, if you watched enough of my videos. You know what to do if a girlfriend cheated on you. You break up and you move on. That's it. Hope that helps.
